info.name: PharmaOS API
info.description:
Complete API collection for PharmaOS pharmacy management platform. 105 endpoints across 20 modules.

Usage: select the "PharmaOS Local" environment, run "Authentication → Login" first (auto-saves {{token}}), then any protected request.

request.description: Returns access + refresh tokens. Test script saves {{token}}, {{refresh_token}}, {{userId}}, {{tenantId}}.
Schedule H/H1/X drugs require doctor + customer, else 422.
section = profile | system | tax | billing | notifications
type = medicines | inventory | customers | vendors | bills | backup
